name: @niivue/nv-ohif
description: NiiVue viewport extension for the OHIF Viewer (render series with NiiVue: 3D volume rendering, meshes, overlays, multiplanar, drawing).

scripts.build:lib: NODE_ENV=production bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir=dist --target=browser --format=esm --external react --external react-dom --external @niivue/niivue --external @niivue/dcm2niix --external dcmjs
scripts.build:package: bun run build:lib && bun run build:types

comment:peers: The host OHIF app (>= 3.12, React 18) provides @ohif/core, @ohif/extension-default and react-dom. They are intentionally NOT peerDependencies here: bun would install the whole OHIF tree (pinned to react-dom 18) into this monorepo, colliding with @niivue/nvreact (React 19). This package builds against local OHIF typings (src/ohif-types.ts) and externalizes react. The react peer allows 18 or 19 so bun reuses the monorepo's React 19 for dev; the component's simple hook usage is compatible with both, and the OHIF host supplies React 18 at runtime.
comment:dcm2niix-pin: DCM2NIIX_PIN: DICOM conversion needs the dcm2niix Web-Worker exit fix (wrap callMain in try/catch, read err.status). The fix is now MERGED upstream in rordenlab/dcm2niix master (commit aae72ac, both js/src/worker.js + worker.jpeg.js) and staged as js/package.json version 1.3.0 — but NOT yet published to npm (latest is still 1.2.0, dev 1.3.0-dev.0, both lacking the fix). So DICOM still does not work for npm-install consumers until the maintainer publishes @niivue/dcm2niix 1.3.0. When it ships, bump the range below to >=1.3.0 and drop the dev-rig local-patched dcm2niix override. See README '## DICOM support'.
comment:uikit-bundled: @niivue/uikit is NOT externalized in build:lib, so its ruler/line/text overlays (and the inlined MSDF font) are bundled into dist. It is therefore a DEV dependency, NOT a runtime one: @niivue/uikit is unpublished (version 0.0.0), so listing it under dependencies would make `npm install @niivue/nv-ohif` 404 on it. Its only @niivue/niivue import is type-only, so no niivue runtime is duplicated.
